name: ext-attack-path-agent-api
description: Reduced-fidelity external attack-path sweep for Tenable Cloud Security via the public GraphQL API with a Bearer API token (no MCP connection). Enforces the subset of the detection contract the GraphQL API can express: internet-direct + wide/all exposure, open findings, network-exploitable (AV:N), and public exploitation evidence (EPSS >= 0.30 OR exploit maturity Functional/High). The API cannot confirm running-state, an observed listening endpoint, AC:Low, CISA-KEV membership, or workload privilege, so output is a candidate list and every report states the gap. For the authoritative de-noised list use the MCP edition. Writes an HTML report; suitable for headless daily runs.
